# Summary / outcome

- What changed, and what outcome does this PR produce?
- For material method changes or improvement claims only: target/opportunity → working hypothesis → observed behavioral/result change; burden/cost limits; next decision/uncertainty (including no-change). Distinguish development, correctness, and usefulness evidence.

## Scope / changed responsibilities

- Changed responsibilities and files:
- Responsibilities intentionally preserved or delegated:
- User, data, runtime, Core/protocol, and compatibility impact:

## Authority / non-goals

- Authority impact:
- Non-goals and actions not taken:

Call out any semantic, execution, external-effect, publication, or merge
authority change explicitly. A shorter PR description must not hide a
meaningful authority, safety, data, or compatibility effect.

## Verification

- Focused checks and results:
- Local Canonical planner result, when applicable:
- Deciding exact-head command and result, when applicable:
- Receipt path and fingerprint, when applicable:

Use the [verification policy](https://github.com/hynk-studio/augnes/blob/main/.github/LOCAL_CANONICAL_VERIFICATION.md) for applicability.
Ordinary prose may state “not applicable”; no invented planner result or receipt.

Include exact environment, Browser/App/MCP/runtime, migration, security,
publication, or structured-evidence details only when the PR actually uses or
changes those surfaces. Local evidence is review material, not hosted
reproduction, approval, publication authority, or merge authority.
